stem_md: 设 $\Omega$ 是由曲面 $z=\frac{x^2+y^2+z^2}{2}$ 与 $z=x^2+y^2$ 所围成含 $z$ 轴的立体区域，则 $\Omega$ 的体积用球面坐标可表示为（ ）
analysis_md:
由
$$
\left\{\begin{array}{l}
z=\frac{x^2+y^2+z^2}{2}\\
z=x^2+y^2
\end{array}\right.,\quad\text{则}\quad
\left\{\begin{array}{l}
x^2+y^2=1\\
z=1
\end{array}\right.,
$$
于是 $\Omega=\Omega_1+\Omega_2$，其中
$$
\Omega_1:\left\{\begin{array}{l}
0\leq\theta\leq2\pi\\
0\leq\varphi\leq\frac{\pi}{4}\\
0\leq r\leq2\cos\varphi
\end{array}\right.,\quad
\Omega_2:\left\{\begin{array}{l}
0\leq\theta\leq2\pi\\
\frac{\pi}{4}\leq\varphi\leq\frac{\pi}{2}\\
0\leq r\leq\frac{\cos\varphi}{\sin^2\varphi}
\end{array}\right.,
$$
于是
$$
V=\iiint_\Omega1\cdot dx\,dy\,dz=\iiint_{\Omega_1}1\cdot dx\,dy\,dz+\iiint_{\Omega_2}1\cdot dx\,dy\,dz
$$
$$
=\int_0^{2\pi}d\theta\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}}d\varphi\int_0^{2\cos\varphi}r^2\sin\varphi\,dr+\int_0^{2\pi}d\theta\int_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}d\varphi\int_0^{\frac{\cos\varphi}{\sin^2\varphi}}r^2\sin\varphi\,dr.
$$
